description:
Dynamic Yield offers AI-powered personalization and recommendation solutions for websites and apps, enabling marketers to deliver tailored experiences and increase conversions.

Personalized recommendations: AI suggests products and content. A/B testing: Test different variations for user segments. Segmentation: Advanced targeting based on user behavior. Real-time analytics: Measure campaign impact instantly.

howToUse.title: Request a Demo or Start Trial
howToUse.description: Visit Dynamic Yield and request a demo or start a trial. A solutions expert will help with onboarding and integration.

howToUse.title: Integrate with Your Site or App
howToUse.description: Install Dynamic Yield’s script or SDK on your website or app to begin collecting user data and serving personalized experiences.

howToUse.title: Set up Campaigns and Segmentation
howToUse.description: Create campaigns and define audience segments based on user behavior, demographics, or custom criteria.

howToUse.title: Deploy A/B Tests and Recommendations
howToUse.description: Use the platform to run A/B or multivariate tests and enable AI-powered content/product recommendations.

howToUse.title: Analyze and Optimize
howToUse.description: Monitor real-time analytics dashboards, review performance by segment, and optimize campaigns for higher conversions.
